map.斜距化平距（本页代码口径，竖直角按度输入先化弧度）：水平距离 D=斜距×cosα: Slope distance reduced to horizontal (page code convention, vertical angle in degrees converted to radians first): horizontal distance D=slope distance×cosα (m); linked values: height difference=slope distance×sinα (m), gradient=tanα×100 (%), difference between slope and horizontal distance=slope distance−D (m). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; at α=0 the horizontal distance equals the slope distance and the height difference is 0, and the gradient rises sharply as the angle increases.
